_meta.name: Contract drafting (public sample)
_meta.description: Public SAMPLE: draft a clause set, graded per rubric criterion by a TEE judge model. Real sets stay private.

prompt: Draft the limitation-of-liability and indemnity clauses for a B2B SaaS agreement between a UK supplier and an EU customer. The customer processes health data in the service.

rubric.criterion: liability cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months
carve-out from the cap for data protection breaches
exclusion of indirect and consequential loss
no exclusion of liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence
mutual IP infringement indemnity with conduct-of-claims procedure

prompt: Draft a mutual NDA term and return-of-information clause for two crypto startups exploring a merger.

rubric.criterion: confidentiality survives termination for a stated period
return or destruction of information on request with written certification
exception for information already public or independently developed
private keys and wallet seed phrases treated as perpetual confidential information
